verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships AI-assisted detection and triage, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence shows Semgrep acting as an MCP client or loading third-party MCP tools. The only MCP evidence (semgrep-probe-3) describes Semgrep's own official MCP server, which is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
